description: Lay out the song's form, heard. Kumi listens to the whole Arrangement quietly (or from_beat for beats) and reads it bar by bar: the energy curve (loudness, density, brightness, low end); the sections it falls into (their bars, role: intro, build, peak, break, verse or outro, and a letter shared by sections that sound alike); the turns between them (a drop or a fall, and what prepares it: a build, a gap or a riser); the intro and outro lengths and the bar the first hook starts on; which tracks play where, from the Arrangement's clips; and the problems a form can have: neighbouring sections without contrast, energy that plateaus, odd phrase lengths, a drop that arrives unprepared, a stretch left unchanged for 32 bars and more. With a reference (an audio file or a clip in the Set), its form too, read in its own bars (its tempo and first downbeat fitted to its onsets, half or double when that's nearer this Set's tempo; this Set's bars when its tempo can't be told), and how the two differ. A whole-song listen takes as long as the song.

from_beat.description: Where to start, in beats (the Arrangement's start when left out)

beats.description: How long, in beats (to the song's last clip when left out)

reference.description: A song to compare the form with: an audio file or a clip in the Set (its clipRef)
